name: Amulet of the Planes
description: A black pendant on which tiny worlds seem to turn.
body:
## What it does

As an action, name a place you know on another plane and make a DC 15 Intelligence check. On a success you are there. On a failure you, and everyone and everything within 15 feet of you, are flung to a random plane.

spells.name: Plane Shift
spells.note: make a DC 15 Intelligence check first; a failure sends you and all within 15 feet to a random plane
